<body>
  <div class="app-shell">
    <header class="app-header">
      <a class="brand" href="#" aria-label="도슨트 모드 처음으로" id="home-button">
        <span class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 36 36"><path d="M4 14h10l2 3h4l2-3h10l-2 11h-8l-2-7h-4l-2 7H6z"/><path d="m4 14-1-4m29 4 1-4"/></svg></span>
        <span><strong>도슨트 모드</strong><small>AI GLASSES · DOCENT MODE</small></span>
      </a>
      <div class="header-actions">
        <span class="version">INTERACTIVE STORY <b>06 SCENES</b></span>
        <button class="icon-button" id="sound-button" aria-label="소리 끄기" title="소리 끄기" aria-pressed="false"></button>
        <button class="icon-button" id="fullscreen-button" aria-label="전체 화면" title="전체 화면"></button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main class="main">
      <div class="stage-wrap">
        <section class="stage" id="stage" aria-label="미술관 관람 시나리오 장면">
          <img id="scene-background" class="scene-background" src="" alt="쇼핑몰에서 스마트 글래스를 터치하는 여성. 스마트폰에 찾는 상품 사진이 보인다." fetchpriority="high">
          <div class="scene-canvas" id="scene-canvas"><div id="overlay-layer" aria-live="polite"></div><div class="smart-glasses-frame" aria-hidden="true"><img class="photographic-frame" src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""></div></div>
        </section>
      </div>

      <div class="subtitle-bar" role="status" aria-live="polite"><span id="subtitle-speaker" class="subtitle-speaker"></span><p id="subtitle-text" class="subtitle-text">재생 버튼을 눌러 이야기를 시작하세요.</p></div>
<section class="player" aria-label="시나리오 재생 컨트롤">
        <div class="player-main">
          <div class="scene-caption">
            <span class="scene-counter" id="scene-counter">SCENE 01 / 06</span>
            <h1 id="scene-title">AI 글래스와 함께하는 미술관 여행</h1>
            <p id="scene-subtitle">미술관 입장 · 음성으로 도슨트 모드 시작</p>
          </div>
          <div class="transport">
            <button class="icon-button" id="replay-button" aria-label="현재 씬 처음부터" title="현재 씬 처음부터"></button>
            <button class="icon-button" id="previous-button" aria-label="이전 씬" title="이전 씬"></button>
            <button class="play-button" id="play-button"><span class="play-symbol" aria-hidden="true"></span><span id="play-label">소리와 함께 시작</span></button>
            <button class="icon-button" id="next-button" aria-label="다음 씬" title="다음 씬"></button>
          </div>
          <div class="playback-options">
            <label class="auto-option"><input type="checkbox" id="auto-next" checked><span class="switch" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>자동 넘김</span></label>
            <p class="playback-status" id="playback-status" role="status">장면부터 천천히 시작해요</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <nav class="scene-navigation" id="scene-navigation" aria-label="씬 선택"></nav>
        <div class="player-footer">
          <p><span class="legend-dot"></span><span id="phase-label">준비</span><span class="divider">/</span>장면 → 발화 → 글래스 UI</p>
          <p id="audio-note">음성: 한국어 AI 음성 <span class="divider">·</span> 작품·해설·DB 연동은 시나리오 예시</p>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  </div>
  <audio id="voice-player" preload="auto"></audio>
<script>window.MUSEUM_IMAGES={"arrival-talk": "data:image/png;base64,
